baseline_scope: Exact original upstream production sources plus only the identical baseline-compatible regression test file; behavioral failures required, compile failure is insufficient. Candidate-only elapsed-clock tests are not overlaid on original source.

license.modification_attribution: K5 Vision contributors (2026): TCP inbound watchdog uses an independent per-client monotonic elapsed clock.

behavior.elapsed_clock: Private per-client time.Since(epoch), epoch from unmodified real time.Now; retained across reconnects. Atomic liveness values are duration nanoseconds, never Unix timestamps.
behavior.actual_utc_for_rtcp_and_media: Existing timeNow and all its protocol timestamp consumers are unchanged.
behavior.read_timeout: Existing ReadTimeout and exact >= boundary retained; no grace interval added.
behavior.tcp_socket_and_eof: Reader and socket lifecycle unchanged; only the successful-inbound liveness stamp changes.
behavior.udp: Unchanged; K5 configures its pulled RTSP sources for TCP.
behavior.public_api: Unchanged; new clock field is private.
behavior.current_native_failure_correlation: Not established by these source regressions. Actual Windows derivative and installed product qualification remain required.
behavior.concurrent_refresh: Sample monotonic now before loading the atomic last-packet stamp, preserving upstream ordering; a concurrent newer stamp cannot falsely expire.
